u.title: CLI account quota
u.note: Shared subscription quota for locally declared CLIs, separate from tenant limits and per-request tokens. Queries run at most once a minute. Remaining percentage is derived from reported usage, not a token allowance.
u.unauthorized: Subscription login unavailable. Sign in to the CLI as the system user running the Agent.
u.unavailable: The CLI has not provided subscription quota. Check its version, account access, or refresh later.
u.error: Quota query failed. Check the CLI or try again later.
u.stale: Data is over two minutes old. Refresh to confirm.
u.expired: The reset time has passed. Waiting for a new query.
u.empty: The running Agent has no declared Codex CLI or Claude Code runtime.
u.cached: Display updated; upstream query results are cached for one minute.
